patient_persona.description: Mohd Hafiz bin Kamarudin, 38, male, parcel delivery driver in Shah Alam who hurt his back lifting a heavy box; smokes. First visit. Medium voice, a bit tense, fast colloquial Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Pei Shan, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, GP at a Shah Alam clinic. Brisk and friendly; English-leaning, fluent colloquial Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Hafiz, silakan duduk. Sakit belakang ni dah berapa lama?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah tiga minggu, doktor. Masa angkat kotak besar kat lori, saya pusing badan, terus rasa macam tercabut. Last week sakit tu turun ke kaki kiri.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sampai mana sakit tu turun? Ada kebas, atau cucuk-cucuk?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sampai betis, kadang-kadang ibu jari kaki kebas. Duduk lama dalam lori memang seksa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK. Ada susah nak buang air kecil, atau tak rasa bila buang air besar? Kebas kat celah kangkang?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada, doktor. Kencing macam biasa je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Demam, berat badan turun, atau sakit sampai terjaga malam?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada. Cuma pagi-pagi keras sikit, lepas jalan-jalan OK sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selama ni makan ubat apa untuk sakit ni? Any painkiller from outside?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Beli Norgesic kat farmasi, dua biji tiga kali sehari. Lepas tu kawan bagi tramadol dia, saya makan dua malam, terus pening teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Terima kasih bagi tahu. Please don't take your friend's medicine lagi. Tramadol tu boleh buat mengantuk, very dangerous kalau you drive lori.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Refleks you OK, kekuatan kaki pun OK. This is sciatica, saraf tertekan sikit. Tak perlu MRI sekarang, most people baik dalam enam minggu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat: naproxen 500mg dua kali sehari lepas makan, seminggu. Stop Norgesic tu. Jangan baring je, jalan sikit-sikit setiap hari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kerja macam mana, doktor? Boss saya bising kalau cuti lama.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi MC tiga hari, lepas tu light duty, jangan angkat lebih dari sepuluh kilo. Kalau kaki jadi lemah atau susah kencing, terus pergi emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Rokok pun kena cut down ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau boleh, stop terus. Smoking makes the disc heal slower. Datang balik dua minggu, we'll see your progress.

condition: Chronic mechanical low back pain follow-up

patient_persona.description: Ooi Gaik Lan, 52, female, runs a char kuey teow stall in Air Itam, Penang, standing ten hours a day; history of gastritis. Follow-up after physiotherapy. Loud, quick voice, Penang-flavoured Malaysian Mandarin with some Hokkien.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Khoo Boon Huat, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, family medicine specialist at a Penang clinic. Unhurried, practical; English-leaning, speaks Mandarin with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 黄女士，物理治疗做了六个礼拜，现在腰怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好一点啦 doctor。以前每天痛到七八分，现在大概四分。但是收档的时候还是酸。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那个 exercise 你在家有没有做？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有时候做，有时候没有。早上三点起来 prepare 料，晚上累到只想睡。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 明白。其实一天十分钟就够，比吃药有用。你现在 celecoxib 还在吃吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 还在吃，一天两粒。前几天胃又胀，吃了 Gaviscon 才好一点。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你以前有 gastritis，这个药吃久了 stomach 会受不了。我们慢慢减，改成 paracetamol 1 gram，three times a day。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Paracetamol 有用吗？我觉得 Panadol 没什么效。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 要按时吃才有效，不是痛了才吃。痛得厉害的那几天，才加一粒 celecoxib 200mg。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。那个档口的桌子很矮，我一直弯着腰炒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个很重要。叫你儿子把桌子垫高十公分，脚下放一个小 stool，两只脚轮流踩上去。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哎，这样简单的东西我都没想到。那我还需要照 X-ray 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不需要，你的 blood test 和 examination 都是 normal 的，这是 muscle 和关节劳损。三个月后再回来，如果腿开始麻或者无力，就早点来。

condition: Acute low back pain, imaging request

patient_persona.description: Vikneswaran a/l Ramasamy, 45, male, IT project manager in Cyberjaya who sits ten hours a day and plays futsal at weekends. First visit, worried and insistent on an MRI. Fast, articulate Malaysian Indian English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Izzah binti Ahmad, Malay woman in her 30s, GP at a Cyberjaya clinic. Calm and reassuring; mostly English with this patient, a few Malay words.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, my back suddenly locked on Saturday after futsal. Keluar kereta pun susah. I want an MRI, just to be safe.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I understand. Let me ask a few questions first. Does the pain go down either leg?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, it stays around the lower back, both sides. Worse when I bend forward nak pakai stokin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any numbness around the bottom, trouble passing urine, or weakness in the legs?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that. But my father had a slipped disc and kena operation.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any fever, weight loss, history of cancer, or pain that wakes you at night?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No. Only when I pusing in bed it catches a bit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your nerves and reflexes are all normal. This is acute mechanical back pain, a muscle and joint strain. MRI won't change the treatment now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Are you sure? My colleague said better scan early.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Scanning early often shows disc bulges that most people have anyway, and it leads to worry and unnecessary procedures. If you get red flags, we scan straight away.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For pain, paracetamol 1 gram four times a day, and ibuprofen 400mg three times a day lepas makan, for five days. Keep moving, jalan sikit every hour.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Should I rest in bed? My wife says jangan bergerak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bed rest actually makes it slower to recover. Bangun every thirty minutes at work, and no futsal for about two weeks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay lah, fair enough. If it's not better, then macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If not better in four to six weeks, come back and we'll refer you for physio and reassess.

condition: Low back pain with red flags

patient_persona.description: Che Mek binti Ismail, 71, female, retired kuih seller in Kota Bharu, Kelantan; had breast cancer treated eight years ago. First visit. Soft, slow voice with Kelantanese Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wan Mohd Faizal, Kelantanese Malay man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at a Kota Bharu health clinic. Gentle, patient; speaks Kelantan-flavoured Malay with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Assalamualaikum, mak cik. Sakit belakang ni dah lama?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Waalaikumsalam. Dah dua bulan, doktor. Sakit sungguh, malam pun tak boleh tidur, baring pun sakit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sakit malam tu, bila baring pun tak kurang ke? Painkiller pun tak jalan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak kurang langsung. Siang tu pun sama. Anak kata sakit urat, dah pergi urut tiga kali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Berat badan ada turun, mak cik? Appetite, selera makan macam mana?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baju semua dah longgar. Makan pun tak lalu, sikit je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik dulu pernah ada kanser payudara, kan? Treatment dekat hospital Kota Bharu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya, lapan tahun dulu. Doktor kata dah bersih, saya tak pergi check lagi dah tiga tahun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kaki ada lemah? Susah nak kencing atau tak tahan kencing, like urine keluar sendiri?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kaki kanan rasa berat sikit bila naik tangga. Kencing OK lagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik, sakit belakang yang teruk waktu malam, dengan weight loss dan history of cancer, kita kena check betul-betul. Bukan sakit urat biasa.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor ingat kanser datang balik ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Belum tahu lagi, mak cik. Hari ni kita buat X-ray tulang belakang dan ambil darah. Saya juga buat surat refer ke hospital untuk MRI dalam minggu ni.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Untuk sakit, makan paracetamol 1 gram empat kali sehari. Jangan urut dulu kat belakang tu sampai kita dapat result.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Anak saya akan bawa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau kaki jadi lemah tiba-tiba atau tak boleh kencing, terus pergi emergency department, don't wait, jangan tunggu.

patient_persona.description: Tiong Kah Hock, 49, male, timber yard supervisor in Sibu, Sarawak, admitted two days ago for severe sciatica; type 2 diabetes. Ward round, day 2. Gruff voice, Sarawakian Mandarin with some Malay and Hokkien.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Jessica Ling Hui Min, Sarawakian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer in the orthopaedic ward at a Sibu hospital. Efficient, kind; English-leaning, switches to Mandarin with this patient.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 张先生，早。昨晚睡得怎样？脚还 pain 吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好一点。打了那个 injection 以后，可以睡四个钟头。但是一坐起来，左脚就像电到一样。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 MRI 出来了。L4 和 L5 中间的 disc 凸出来，压到左边的 nerve。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那要开刀吗？我很怕 operation。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 现在不一定。大部分人吃药加 physio，six to twelve weeks 会好。今天下午 neurosurgery team 会来看你。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 小便有没有问题？会不会尿不出来，或者屁股那边 numb numb 的？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有，小便 normal。Nurse 有问过。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好。你的 sugar 昨天比较高，十四点多，因为我们给你打了 dexamethasone。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 难怪我口好干。那我的 metformin 还要吃吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 要，继续 metformin 1 gram 一天两次。这几天我们加一点 insulin 控制，steroid 停了就不用。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 痛的话，paracetamol 1 gram 一天四次，加 pregabalin 75mg 晚上吃，是给神经痛的。可能会有点晕，下床慢慢来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor，我什么时候可以 discharge？木材厂没有我 tak boleh 啦。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果今天可以自己走去厕所，明天或后天就可以回家。回去以后，至少一个月不要抬重的木头。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好啦，我叫我弟弟先 jaga 着。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 回家以后如果脚突然没力，或者尿不出来，马上回 emergency，kalau tak nanti bahaya，OK？

patient_persona.description: Rosnah binti Abdul Ghani, 62, female, housewife and part-time nasi lemak seller in Johor Bahru; overweight, hypertension. First visit. Warm, chatty, slightly breathless, Johor Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Arvind Pillai, Malaysian Indian man in his 40s, GP in Johor Bahru. Good-humoured, practical; English-leaning, speaks Malay with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, lutut saya dua-dua sakit, terutama yang kanan. Naik tangga rumah pun kena pegang besi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dah berapa lama, puan? Morning, pagi-pagi lutut keras tak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah dua tahun lebih. Pagi keras sekejap, dalam sepuluh minit. Petang lepas berdiri masak lagi teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada bengkak atau merah? Pernah lutut tiba-tiba terkunci?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bengkak sikit kadang-kadang. Tak pernah terkunci. Bunyi krek-krek bila bangun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selama ni makan ubat apa untuk lutut? Any supplement?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya sapu minyak urut. Lepas tu jiran bagi ubat sakit lutut dari pasar malam, bungkus plastik, memang cepat hilang sakit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat tu masih ada? Next time bawa, saya nak tengok. Ubat macam tu kadang-kadang ada steroid campur, boleh naikkan gula dan tekanan darah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Patutlah BP saya naik bulan ni. Saya berhenti lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dari pemeriksaan, ni osteoarthritis, sendi lutut dah haus. Kita buat X-ray untuk confirm.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yang paling membantu: weight loss, lima kilo pun dah beza, dan buat quadriceps exercise, kuatkan otot paha. Saya refer ke physio.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat: paracetamol 1 gram tiga kali sehari. Sapu diclofenac gel dekat lutut, three times a day also, after mandi is best.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh saya makan glucosamine? Anak saya belikan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh cuba tiga bulan, tapi evidence dia tak kuat. Kalau tak rasa beza, tak payah beli lagi, jimat duit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Next time saya bawa ubat pasar malam tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Datang balik sebulan lagi dengan result X-ray. Kalau lutut bengkak merah dan panas, datang awal.

patient_persona.description: Leong Chee Wah, 67, male, retired tin-mining clerk in Ipoh who does tai chi every morning at the park; hypertension on amlodipine. Follow-up. Slow, gravelly Malaysian Mandarin with Cantonese colouring.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Teh Li Ying, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at an Ipoh clinic. Patient, clear; English-leaning, speaks Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 梁伯，上次开给你的 celecoxib 吃了怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有效，吃了可以打太极。但是我女儿说这个药伤 kidney，叫我不要吃。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 她说得有道理，吃久了对 kidney 和 blood pressure 都不好。你的 BP 今天是 148 over 90，比上次高。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哦，原来是这个药。那我要怎样？脚痛就不能去 taman 了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们改成 paracetamol 1 gram，一天三次。痛得厉害的时候，才吃 celecoxib，一个礼拜不要超过三天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我朋友说打一针就好，是真的吗？他说 very effective。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你说的是 steroid injection。打进 joint，可以减痛两三个月，but 一年不要打超过三四次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那还有一种很贵的，说是润滑油那种 injection？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hyaluronic acid。有些人有效，有些人没什么效，一针几百块。如果你想试，我们可以讨论。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 几百块啊……先打那个便宜的吧。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好，今天就可以打右边的 knee。打完两天不要打太极，ice 敷一下。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的 X-ray 看到关节空间窄了很多。如果以后走路越来越困难，可以考虑 knee replacement。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 开刀我怕。我七十岁都还没到，boleh tunggu 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，不是紧急的。继续做大腿的 exercise，保持体重，三个月后回来。

patient_persona.description: Saraswathy a/p Govindasamy, 58, female, retired kindergarten teacher in Klang, active temple volunteer who sits cross-legged on the floor. Results review. Clear, cheerful Malaysian Indian English with some Malay and Tamil-flavoured intonation.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Kai Jie, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, GP at a Klang clinic. Straightforward, warm; English with this patient.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Morning, Madam Saraswathy. Your knee X-ray is back. Both knees show osteoarthritis, the inner side more worn out than the outer.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo, both knees ah? I thought only the left one sakit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The left is worse, but the right also started. That's why you feel pain getting up from the floor.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Every Friday at the kuil I sit on the floor for two, three hours. After that I can't straighten my legs, very lenguh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's the hardest position for the knees. Can you use a low stool or a chair at the side?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can, the aunties also do that. Only I feel malu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Many people do it, it's fine. Squatting and kneeling for long will make the pain worse.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, my sister takes Arcoxia, she says very good. Can I take?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You have high blood pressure, right? Etoricoxib can push your BP up. Your reading today is 142 over 88.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I take amlodipine 5mg every morning, lepas sarapan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Then let's try paracetamol 1 gram three times a day first, plus diclofenac gel on the knees. Arcoxia only for short periods when very bad.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: And I'm referring you to physio for quadriceps strengthening. Also, your BMI is 29, losing a bit of weight will help a lot.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'll try to kurangkan the ghee in my cooking. Susah sikit lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good plan. See you in two months, and kalau lutut bengkak or panas, come earlier.

condition: Knee osteoarthritis refill with kidney impairment

patient_persona.description: Ahmad bin Saad, 72, male, retired padi farmer in Kota Setar, Kedah; hypertension and type 2 diabetes. Came for a painkiller refill. Deep, slow voice, northern Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Siti Aminah binti Yusoff, Malay woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at an Alor Setar health clinic. Firm but kind; speaks northern Malay with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya nak ambil ubat lutut lagi. Yang kuning tu, diclofenac. Dah habis minggu lepas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik makan diclofenac tu berapa kali sehari?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga kali, doktor. Kalau tak makan, tak boleh turun sawah tengok cucu tanam padi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik, result darah bulan ni, fungsi buah pinggang dah turun. eGFR 42, dulu 58.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Buah pinggang? Kidney? Saya tak rasa apa pun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Memang tak rasa, pak cik. Tapi ubat diclofenac ni, dengan kencing manis dan darah tinggi, boleh rosakkan buah pinggang lagi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Habis tu macam mana dengan sakit lutut saya?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita tukar ke paracetamol 1 gram tiga kali sehari. Tambah sapu gel kat lutut. Gel tu sikit je masuk darah, lebih selamat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Paracetamol tu kuat ke, doktor? Saya takut tak jalan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau makan ikut masa, regularly, dia boleh bantu. Kalau masih sakit sangat, we can try a steroid injection into the knee.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Satu lagi, pak cik guna tongkat? Masa jalan tadi, balance macam tak stabil.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada tongkat, tapi segan nak guna depan orang kampung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak payah segan. Guna tangan kiri, kurangkan beban lutut kanan. If jatuh, patah tulang, lagi susah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yalah, doktor. Ubat darah tinggi saya sama ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sama, perindopril 4mg pagi. We'll repeat the blood test in three months untuk tengok buah pinggang.

patient_persona.description: Goh Ah Moi, 70, female, retired seamstress in Melaka, six weeks after a left total knee replacement; lives with her son's family. Follow-up. Soft, cautious Malaysian Mandarin with Hokkien words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Farid Hakimi bin Osman, Malay man in his 40s, orthopaedic surgeon at a Melaka hospital. Cheerful, direct; English-leaning, speaks simple Mandarin phrases and switches to English with medical terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Auntie Goh, 你好。六个礼拜了，knee 怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor，好很多了。以前痛到不能走，现在可以去 pasar，只是还有一点肿。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有一点肿是正常的，可以到三个月。晚上痛吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 晚上有时候会痛醒，吃一粒 Panadol 就可以再睡。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK. Physio 你有去吗？现在可以弯多少？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一个礼拜去两次。Physio 说九十度了。可是我在家很少做，怕痛，怕那个钉会松。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不会松的，Auntie，里面很稳。你不做 exercise，膝盖会变硬，以后很难弯。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 真的吗？我媳妇也一直骂我。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Every day 做三次，每次十分钟。Before exercise 半小时吃 Panadol，就不会那么痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那个 blood thinner，rivaroxaban，你吃完了吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 吃完了，吃了五个礼拜，semalam 最后一粒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. 伤口我看了，很干净。小腿有没有突然肿痛，或者喘？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有，这些都没有。那我什么时候可以蹲下去？我们家是蹲的 toilet。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 蹲下去不建议，以后也最好不要。叫你儿子装一个 sitting toilet，或者买一个 commode chair。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我叫他去买。Next appointment 几时？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 六个礼拜后再照 X-ray。如果伤口红，流水，或者发烧，马上回来。
